text:
cassie: quick UX check — in the Trace Inspector, users keep missing the 'Export as JSON/CSV' action. should we surface it as a left-aligned primary button next to the correlation id, or keep it in the kebab and add a tooltip?
rafa: +1 to surfacing it. during postmortems we want one-click export. kebab is too hidden.
mina: agree that discoverability matters, but a primary button might compete with the 'Copy correlation id' affordance. could we combine: small export icon next to the id and a full Export button in the header for bulk export?
oliver: what about accessibility? if we add an icon next to the id we must ensure accessible name and keyboard focus. aria-label="Export trace" and a visible focus ring.
cassie: good call. mock suggestion: [Export icon] COPY [id]  — icon opens quick export menu, full Export in header. keeps copy prominent.
rafa: love that. Also copy text tweak: currently the copy button tooltip says "Copied!" but for long trace IDs maybe show "Copied trace id" so users know what landed in clipboard.
mina: yes. tooltip copy text -> "Trace ID copied". Also ask: should exported filename include trace timestamp + id? ops requested that for correlating artifacts.
oliver: filename pattern suggestion: redwood-trace-<YYYYMMDD>-<shortid>.json. keep <shortid> to first 8 chars of id to avoid super long names.
cassie: accessibility nit: when export dialog opens, focus should move into dialog and back to the export button on close. Also ensure Escape closes it.
mina: keyboard flow: Tab order inside dialog should be export format radio, include spans checkbox, filename input, confirm button. Confirm should be secondary? I think primary.
rafa: copy/aria copy: add role="button" and aria-describedby linking to a live region update: "Trace ID copied" so screenreader announces success.
oliver: dev note: we should debounce the copy live region updates to avoid repeated announcements when quickly clicking.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-23T18:00Z for the trace-inspector-copy-nits branch.
cassie: tiny copy nits for dialog title: change from "Export" -> "Export trace". and confirm button text from "OK" -> "Export".
mina: also add a small helper line under filename: "We’ll include the timestamp for you — edit if needed." keeps it friendly.
rafa: will update the figma — @oliver can you add aria labels to the prototype components?
oliver: yup i’ll drop them in. i'll also add keyboard-only focus styles in the CSS tokens doc.
cassie: thanks team — i'll push a short blurb into release notes for staging so SREs know the filename change. anyone want to split the checklist?
mina: i'll own copy updates + dialog a11y checklist.
rafa: i'll land the header export button mock and tooltip changes.
oliver: i'll do the aria + focus behavior and QA keyboard nav.
cassie: let’s reconvene after staging deploy. :thumbsup:
